deps.edn.reason: The git floors on test, edn and text point at repositories that are bundled here as kotoba.test, kotoba.edn and kotoba.text; they become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. :paths and :aliases are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the source and test paths.

test/cbor/core_golden_test.cljk.reason: The suite reads its golden corpus by a path relative to the old repository root (test/cbor/golden.edn). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so the path names the corpus where it now lives (lib/org.ietf.cbor/test/cbor/golden.edn). Nothing else in the file changes.

src/cbor/core.cljk.reason: AWAI-531: add opt-in host-only bounded CBOR/IPLD decoding while retaining existing decode behavior.

test/cbor/bounded_decode_test.cljk.reason: AWAI-531: exercise bounded decoding and rejection on local host oracles.

test/bounded-decode-evidence.md.reason: AWAI-531: dated local oracle evidence and coverage limitations.
